opportunities.name: Ryanair one-way/return flight search
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair flights for a chosen origin airport, destination airport, outbound date and optional return date, with an optional promo code, then pick the outbound and return flights.
steps: Click the 'From' field and choose the origin airport (type it or pick from the list).
Click the 'To' field and choose the destination airport or country and city.
Open the date picker and select the outbound date, navigating months with the month controls if needed.
Select the return date if the trip is round-trip.
Optionally click 'Apply promo code', type the code and apply it.
Click 'Search'.
Click 'Select' for the outbound flight, then 'Select' for the return flight, and choose a fare if prompted.

instances.values: To = Athens (Greece); dates picked on calendar around 2 Apr and 5 May 2023; origin left at default; Search, then Select x2
From = Dublin; To = Malta; date 22 selected; Done on date picker; Search

From = Dublin (Ireland); To = Paris Beauvais (France); dates 26 and 2; promo code 1000001 applied; Search

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and notify-for-table
opportunities.description: Search Resy for a restaurant by name or cuisine, open its listing, pick the meal, date and party size, and request a notification for a table, with an optional preferred end time.
steps: Click the 'Search restaurants, cuisines, etc.' box and type the restaurant name or cuisine.
Click the matching restaurant heading in the results.
If needed, choose the location, date and guest count.
Click 'Notify for Dinner' or 'Notify for Lunch'.
If a preferred end time is offered, select it from the 'Preferred end time' dropdown.
Click 'Confirm'.

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date
opportunities.description: Find an attraction or tour on Booking.com by searching a place name or browsing a category, choose a visit date, and open an attraction's availability.
steps: Click the 'Attractions' tab.
Either type the attraction or destination into the search box and select the suggestion, or click a category (for example 'Asia') and then the destination tile (for example 'Kyoto').
Click 'Select your dates' and tick the desired date in the calendar.
Click 'Search' if the search form is shown.
Open the attraction heading from the results.
Optionally sort or filter (for example 'Most popular'), click 'See availability' or 'Show more dates', and click 'Next' to page through availability.
parameters: attraction or destination name, or category

instances.values: typed 'Aquarium of Paris'; date 5 May 2023; Search; opened the heading; closed two overlays with svg clicks

category Attractions > Asia, then destination 'Kyoto'; date 25 May 2023; sort 'Most popular'; See availability; Show more dates; Next. Occurrence was interrupted by roughly 800 s of other sites (Resy, Ryanair, GameStop) before resuming at 2266.3

opportunities.name: Event ticket search with category or artist and date filter
opportunities.description: Find sports or concert tickets by choosing a category or searching an artist, then narrow the listings by a date or date range.
opportunities.site: ticketcenter (sports listings); seatgeek.com (concert search). Same pattern across two ticket sites, so lower confidence.
steps: Pick a category (for example 'SPORTS') or type an artist or team in the search box and select the suggestion.
Choose the league or event link (for example 'All MLB Tickets') if browsing a category.
Open the date filter ('All dates' or 'Filter by Date').
Pick a preset (for example 'This weekend') or navigate the calendar ('Next month') and click a day.
Click 'Apply' if shown, and open 'TICKETS' or the listing.
parameters: category or league, or artist/team name

instances.values: SPORTS > All MLB Tickets > All dates > This weekend > TICKETS
search 'Coldplay'; selected suggestion; Filter by Date > Next month > day 17 > Apply
